data.heading: Brain
data.rubric: Roll the mouse over any of the labels to know about each part.
data.text: The brain is part of the body's nervous system. It controls speech, thought, balance, movement, the senses, emotions, dreams, and all body functions.
The brain sends messages around the body so that each part knows what to do and when to do it.
The messages from the brain travel at more than 240 km per hour. Much, much faster than a cheetah can run!
The cerebrum is the largest part of the brain. It has four parts.
The frontal lobe controls your thoughts and feelings, your way of thinking and understanding, planning, and problem solving.
The parietal lobe controls movement, recognition, and the sense of touch, taste, and temperature.
The occipital lobe helps you to see and identify different things.
The temporal lobe controls memory and speech and helps you to understand what you hear.
The cerebellum helps you maintain your balance, control your movement, and makes your muscles move together.
The brain stem connects the brain to the rest of the body.
